name: PINBALL
summary: Amazon brand selling PETG (standard, rainbow, clear rainbow) and PLA (standard, matte rainbow, silk rainbow/dual/tri-colour, glow), led by bulk PETG bundles of 2-10 kg at $8-15/kg, the cheapest bulk PETG on the deal tracker. 1 kg spools run about $14-19/kg. The seller is a Cixi technology company.

product_lines.name: PETG
product_lines.notes: 1 kg $13.99-14.99; 2, 4, 8 and 10 x 1 kg bundles down to $79.99 for 10 kg ($8/kg).

product_lines.name: PETG Rainbow / Clear Rainbow
product_lines.notes: 1 kg $15.99-16.99; 4 x 1 kg $39.99-41.99. No gradient-PETG id exists, so mapped to petg.

product_lines.name: PLA and PLA Matte Rainbow
product_lines.notes: 8 x 1 kg bundles $81-95; 1 kg matte rainbow $18.99; 4 x 250 g packs.
